applicability: Unranked possible domains with source-declared common/important subsets and explicitly modeled operational defaults; no universal compound-state or molecular-spin claim.

default_policy.common_without_important: Choose the least absolute nonzero common state, then the smaller signed value on equal absolute value; an operational tie break, not a source preference.
default_policy.multiple_important: Choose the least absolute nonzero important state, then the smaller signed value on equal absolute value; an operational tie break, not a frequency ranking.
default_policy.no_compound_preference: Use modeled elemental-reference zero without adding it to observed common/important states or to the possible domain.
default_policy.precedence: valid explicit state > applicable specific chemical rule > element operational default
default_policy.scope: Element priors only. Scoped lanthanide/actinide rules may override defaults in their own applicability domain. Oxidation states do not establish local or molecular spin.
default_policy.unique_important: Use the sole RSC source-emphasized important state as the operational default.
